description: This file defines a final class 'ImmutableThingFromCopyBuilder' which implements builder interfaces for creating immutable 'Thing' objects based on copying existing 'Thing' instances or JSON representations. It provides a fluent API for setting and removing properties of a 'Thing', including permissions, attributes, features, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, metadata, and ID. The class also handles parsing of date fields and supports deprecated permission-setting methods.

classes.name: ImmutableThingFromCopyBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating immutable 'Thing' instances by copying existing 'Thing' objects or JSON representations, with a fluent API for setting various properties and features.

methods.name: of (Thing)
methods.description: Initializes a new builder instance with properties from an existing 'Thing'.

methods.name: of (JsonObject)
methods.description: Initializes a new builder instance from a JSON object representing a 'Thing'.

methods.name: tryToParseModified
methods.description: Attempts to parse the 'modified' timestamp from a JSON field, throwing a JsonParseException if parsing fails.

methods.name: tryToParseCreated
methods.description: Attempts to parse the 'created' timestamp from a JSON field, throwing a JsonParseException if parsing fails.

methods.name: tryToParseDate
methods.description: Helper method to parse ISO-8601 date string into Instant, with error handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the immutable 'Thing' object based on current builder properties.

methods.name: setPermissions (various overloads)
methods.description: Sets permissions on the 'Thing' for specified authorization subjects and permissions, deprecated methods included.

methods.name: setPolicyId
methods.description: Sets the policy ID for the 'Thing'.

methods.name: removePolicyId
methods.description: Removes the policy ID from the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of the 'Thing', accepting various JSON or Attributes representations.

methods.name: removeAllAttributes
methods.description: Removes all attributes from the 'Thing'.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specific attribute by JSON pointer.

methods.name: setNullAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes to null, clearing all attributes.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets or removes the 'Thing' definition.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets a feature in the 'Thing' by feature object or ID.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by feature ID.

methods.name: setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Sets a feature's definition.

methods.name: removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes a feature's definition.

methods.name: setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a property on a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a property from a feature.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets multiple features from JSON or iterable collections.

methods.name: removeAllFeatures
methods.description: Removes all features.

methods.name: setNullFeatures
methods.description: Sets features to null.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle of the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision of the 'Thing' by object or revision number.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the 'modified' timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the 'created' timestamp.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Sets the metadata associated with the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the 'Thing' ID from string or ThingId object.

methods.name: setGeneratedId
methods.description: Generates and sets a new ID for the 'Thing'.
